Petvet Care Centers, LLC | First Lien Revolver | S + 6.00 % | 11/15/2029 | 35 | 30 | 7 | 8,23

findings.detail: The Petvet term loan identifier carries maturity 2031-08-07, but the source row states 11/15/2030 and the structured maturity is 2030-11-15.
The Petvet revolver identifier carries maturity 2030-11-15, but the source row states 11/15/2029 and the structured maturity is 2029-11-15.

rationale: Class 2 within-row review. Raw SOI table 33 shows Petvet Care Centers term loan maturity as 11/15/2030 and revolver maturity as 11/15/2029. Those values match the structured XBRL residuals in the flag rows, while the extracted identifiers carry later dates from neighboring/incorrect rows. The defect is therefore in identifier maturity extraction, not in the structured maturity field.
